name: memmy-agent
description: TypeScript refactor of memmy's agent runtime.

scripts.prebuild: npm run version:sync && npm --prefix ../../Migrations run build
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run version:sync && npm --prefix ../../Migrations run build
scripts.pretest: npm run version:sync && npm --prefix ../../Migrations run build
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); for (const target of ["dist/skills/memory","dist/skills/my"]) fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true}); for (const target of ["dist/core/agent-runtime/tools/self.js","dist/core/agent-runtime/tools/self.js.map","dist/core/agent-runtime/tools/self.d.ts","dist/core/agent-runtime/tools/runtime-state.js","dist/core/agent-runtime/tools/runtime-state.js.map","dist/core/agent-runtime/tools/runtime-state.d.ts"]) fs.rmSync(target,{force:true})' && find src/templates src/skills -type f ! -name '*.ts' -exec sh -c 'for file do target="dist/${file#src/}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"; cp -p "$file" "$target"; done' sh {} +
